content.short: 7K Aggregator is a high-efficiency DEX aggregator on Sui that optimizes trade routes across multiple liquidity sources.
content.description: 7K Aggregator is a next-generation decentralized exchange aggregator built on the Sui blockchain, designed to provide traders with the best possible swap rates. By integrating with all major liquidity protocols on Sui, including AMMs and CLMMs, 7K utilizes advanced routing algorithms to split trades across multiple paths, significantly reducing slippage and price impact. The platform features an intuitive interface for retail users while offering deep liquidity for institutional-grade trading. As a core piece of Sui's DeFi infrastructure, 7K enables seamless asset exchange with minimal gas overhead and maximum capital efficiency for the entire ecosystem.
content.meta: Discover 7K Aggregator, the leading Sui DEX aggregator for optimized trading, low slippage, and deep liquidity across the Sui DeFi ecosystem.
